system_prompt: You are a careful causal discovery expert. Your task is to convert variable semantics into a plausible causal order prior. Do not claim that the order is ground truth. Return strict JSON only.
rationale: Lifestyle/exposure variables come first, followed by diseases they can cause. Smoking is upstream of bronchitis and lung cancer; travel to Asia raises tuberculosis risk. Dyspnoea and positive X-ray are downstream clinical manifestations/measurements of disease, so they are later.
